text: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction
full: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

text: She weepeth sore in the night
full: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

text: Surely he hath borne our griefs
full: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

text: My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death
full: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

text: But I am poor and sorrowful
full: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

text: And they began to be sorrowful
full: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

text: And they were exceeding sorrowful
full: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

text: And the graves were opened
full: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,

text: And came out of the graves after his resurrection
full: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.

text: signifying what death he should die
full: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

text: The ways of Zion do mourn
full: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

text: and began to be sorrowful and very heavy
full: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

text: a man of sorrows
full: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

text: why hast thou forsaken me?
full: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

text: why hast thou forsaken me?
full: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

text: because he hath poured out his soul unto death
full: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

text: And he made his grave with the wicked
full: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.

text: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day
full: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.

text: My soul is exceeding sorrowful
full: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

text: and thou hast brought me into the dust of death
full: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

text: I am weary of my crying
full: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

text: I have cried day and night before thee
full: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

text: and mine acquaintance into darkness
full: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

text: Free among the dead
full: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

text: two parts therein shall be cut off and die
full: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the LORD, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.

text: and behold my sorrow
full: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

text: my bowels are troubled
full: Behold, O LORD; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

text: and the power of darkness
full: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

text: led with him to be put to death
full: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.

text: All ye shall be offended because of me this night
full: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

text: even in this night
full: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

text: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead
full: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

text: All ye shall be offended because of me this night
full: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

text: lest his disciples come by night
full: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

text: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning
full: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

text: weeping may endure for a night
full: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

text: My tears have been my meat day and night
full: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

text: and their widows made no lamentation
full: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

text: the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom
full: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

text: let tears run down like a river day and night
full: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

text: cry out in the night
full: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

text: And at midnight there was a cry made
full: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

text: and all the widows stood by him weeping
full: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

text: And her gates shall lament and mourn
full: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.

text: Weep ye not for the dead
full: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

text: My face is foul with weeping
full: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

text: and his widows shall not weep
full: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

text: Mine eyes do fail with tears
full: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

text: weeping as they went up
full: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

text: Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day
full: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

text: Refrain thy voice from weeping
full: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

text: They shall come with weeping
full: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.

text: weeping and supplications of the children of Israel
full: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the LORD their God.

text: weeping all along as he went
full: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

text: I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer
full: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes
full: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

text: This is a lamentation
full: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

text: take up a lamentation for Tyrus
full: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;

text: take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus
full: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

text: take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt
full: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

text: there sat women weeping for Tammuz
full: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.

text: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out
full: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.

text: I will water thee with my tears
full: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

text: I have seen thy tears
full: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

text: The earth mourneth and fadeth away
full: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about
full: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

text: make no mourning for the dead
full: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.

text: behold darkness and sorrow
full: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.

text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about
full: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

text: The sorrows of death compassed me
full: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

text: The sorrows of death compassed me
full: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

text: For all his days are sorrows
full: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.

text: It is better to go to the house of mourning
full: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.

text: and sorrow and mourning shall flee away
full: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

text: I went mourning without the sun
full: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

text: My harp also is turned to mourning
full: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.

text: I am afraid of all my sorrows
full: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

text: I should then have perished in mine affliction
full: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

text: And when the mourning was past
full: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.

text: The new wine mourneth
full: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

text: The earth mourneth and languisheth
full: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.

text: Enter not into the house of mourning
full: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even lovingkindness and mercies.

text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god
full: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing
full: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

text: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked
full: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

text: I go mourning all the day long
full: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

text: Mine eye is consumed because of grief
full: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

text: I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit
full: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.

text: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks
full: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

text: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning
full: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

text: all of them mourning
full: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.

text: saw the mourning in the floor of Atad
full: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

text: And when the days of his mourning were past
full: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

text: To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction
full: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

text: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust
full: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

text: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave
full: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

text: our dance is turned into mourning
full: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

text: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful
full: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

text: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it
full: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

text: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit
full: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

text: Died Abner as a fool dieth?
full: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

text: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones
full: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

text: And this woman’s child died in the night
full: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

text: Which remain among the graves
full: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

text: out of their graves
full: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

text: I will open your graves
full: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

text: He will swallow up death in victory
full: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.

text: They shall die of grievous deaths
full: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

text: And the whole valley of the dead bodies
full: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.

text: One dieth in his full strength
full: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

text: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul
full: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

text: Because there were no graves in Egypt
full: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

text: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden
full: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

text: signifying what death he should die
full: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

text: lest I sleep the sleep of death
full: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

text: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away
full: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

text: there shall be many dead bodies in every place
full: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord GOD: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.

text: And I find more bitter than death the woman
full: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.

text: neither hath he power in the day of death
full: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.

text: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba
full: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

text: (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni
full: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

text: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died
full: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

text: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died
full: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

text: Thy father did command before he died
full: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

text: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth
full: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

text: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave
full: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

text: Yet shall he be brought to the grave
full: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

text: they are in the terrors of the shadow of death
full: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

text: Dead things are formed from under the waters
full: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

text: Destruction and death say
full: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

text: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death
full: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

text: Which long for death
full: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

text: In famine he shall redeem thee from death
full: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

text: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age
full: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

text: hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not
full: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

text: Last of all the woman died also
full: Last of all the woman died also.

text: last of all the woman died also
full: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

text: And last of all the woman died also
full: And last of all the woman died also.

text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness
full: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

text: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark
full: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

text: and the people shall be troubled at midnight
full: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

text: The moon and stars to rule by night
full: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

text: All his days also he eateth in darkness
full: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.

text: A land of darkness
full: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

text: He discovereth deep things out of darkness
full: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

text: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness
full: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

text: He shall not depart out of darkness
full: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

text: I have made my bed in the darkness
full: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

text: He shall be driven from light into darkness
full: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

text: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places
full: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

text: He setteth an end to darkness
full: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

text: There is no darkness
full: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

text: Let that day be darkness
full: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

text: They meet with darkness in the daytime
full: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

text: and the darkness he called Night
full: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

text: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness
full: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.

text: before he cause darkness
full: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.

text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness
full: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

text: He made darkness his secret place
full: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

text: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness
full: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

text: yet let him remember the days of darkness
full: But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.

text: and behold trouble and darkness
full: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.

text: And the light shineth in darkness
full: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

text: and brought me into darkness
full: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

text: thy body also is full of darkness
full: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

text: What I tell you in darkness
full: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

text: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness
full: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

text: The people which sat in darkness saw great light
full: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

text: thy whole body shall be full of darkness
full: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

text: The way of the wicked is as darkness
full: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

text: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness
full: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

text: because the darkness is past
full: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

text: neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows
full: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

text: We are orphans and fatherless
full: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

text: Thou hast sent widows away empty
full: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

text: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow
full: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

text: many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias
full: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

text: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows
full: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.

text: But the younger widows refuse
full: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

text: If any man or woman that believeth have widows
full: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

text: Honour widows that are widows indeed
full: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

text: because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration
full: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

text: that widows may be their prey
full: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!

text: he relieveth the fatherless and widow
full: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

text: and a judge of the widows
full: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

text: they have made her many widows in the midst thereof
full: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

text: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow
full: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

text: Yet because this widow troubleth me
full: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

text: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished
full: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.

text: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy
full: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

text: Which perished at Endor
full: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

text: They shall cut down her forest
full: They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.

text: His flesh is consumed away
full: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

text: My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD
full: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:

text: The good man is perished out of the earth
full: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.

text: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity
full: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

text: or the pitcher be broken at the fountain
full: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.

text: neither cut down any out of the forests
full: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.

text: And shall consume the glory of his forest
full: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.

text: and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed
full: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
